$comment: What each credential or CLI is for. Data only: providers are named here and in store adapters, never in logic. Match is a regex on the secret NAME (and, for stores, optional path prefix). Never put a value here.

credentials.use: Machine identity for the secret store. `ae inventory` and `ae bundle` log in with it; read other secrets through the store at call time, never copy them into files.
Session-scoped GitHub token used by `gh`/git. Scope is whatever the harness granted; prefer the harness's GitHub tools where present.
Fleet maintenance PAT. Used by hyper-agents ops broker only; owner renews it yearly.

Cloudflare API (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4, Bearer): zones, DNS, Tunnels, Access apps and policies. Verify with GET /user/tokens/verify. Write scopes are proven by the first op that uses them.
Access application audience / service token for the ops Access app. Deploy tooling only.
Connector token for the core tunnel. Read by the host's tunnel daemon only.
Encrypts infrastructure state. Infra tooling only.
Server host API (provisioning). Infra tooling only.
Deploy SSH key pair for the core host. Deploy tooling only.
Backup encryption and target. Backup jobs only.
Model API key; the prefix (DEV_, REVIEW_, BRAIN_) names the consumer. Use only from the consumer it names.
Model API key; the prefix names the consumer (DEV_, REVIEW_, DEEP_SEARCH_, usage reporting).
Model API key; the prefix names the consumer.
Kilo gateway key for development.
Per-controller LifeOS agents:request tokens, minted and renewed by the ops broker. Never paste or print.
Broker only. No other workload may read the value (MB-011).
LifeOS deploy configuration. Deploy tooling only.
Agent instruction bundle; `ae bundle` materializes it at session start.
Harness-provided cloud credential. Check its purpose before use; never assume it is the owner's.
Short-lived token for `gcloud`/`bq`/`gsutil`, provided by the harness.
